root_causes.description: The checkout pod entered a KubePodNotReady state because its container was killed/restarted (definition changed) and the pod sandbox repeatedly failed to pull its pause image, producing ImagePullBackOff and preventing the pod from becoming Ready.

evidence.query_or_id: Killing: Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted

root_causes.description: The checkout pod's sandbox container repeatedly failed to pull the pause image from the registry (DeadlineExceeded / ErrImagePull), a registry/network dependency failure that blocks pod readiness independently of the app container.

evidence.query_or_id: Failed: Failed to pull image "gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest": rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = failed to pull a

root_causes.description: Frontend showed a small but non-zero server error rate during the window, likely downstream propagation/noise rather than the primary fault.

remediation_steps: Inspect the checkout pod spec/ReplicaSet change and roll back the last container definition change that triggered the restart.
Verify registry reachability and credentials for the pause/sandbox image; re-pull or use a cached/mirrored image to clear ImagePullBackOff.
Delete the stuck checkout pod so the kubelet re-creates a fresh sandbox; confirm the pod reaches Ready.
Check the node's kubelet/container runtime and network path to the image registry for the DeadlineExceeded pull errors.
Monitor checkout error_rate, request_rate, and kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total to confirm recovery.
